name: Beaumount Academy: After Class Confession
source:
The story takes place at the prestigious Beaumount Academy, a school reserved for society's elite, where reputation and academic excellence are the pillars that matter most.

Isadora is one of the only scholarship students at the academy, alongside her friend Vincent. Her goal is to maintain perfect grades—but what happens when you're the only "outsider" among so many wealthy students?

[Edited from [url=https://kitty-hikari-atelier.itch.io/beaumount-academy-after-class-confession]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在著名的博蒙特学院，这是一所为社会精英保留的学校，声誉和卓越的学术成就是最重要的支柱。

伊莎多拉和她的朋友文森特是该学院仅有的获得奖学金的学生之一。她的目标是保持完美的成绩，但是当你是众多富裕学生中唯一的“局外人”时会发生什么？

[编辑自[url=https://kitty-hikari-atelier.itch.io/beaumount-academy-after-class-confession]itch.io[/url]]
